popCulture.title: Alcyone (mythology)
popCulture.description: Aeolus' daughter and Ceyx's wife — their sea-grief becomes the halcyon birds and the calm midwinter days.

popCulture.title: Ceyx
popCulture.description: The Trachinian king drowned on the voyage Alcyone begged him not to take — Ovid's emblem of married love past death.
